title: Dua Lipa Soaks Up Newlywed Life With Callum Turner in Intimate Honeymoon Photos: ‘Heaven on Earth’
summary: The pair tied the knot and celebrated with a second wedding earlier in June.
contentText:
Dua Lipa and Callum Turner are saying buongiorno to life as a married couple, with the pop star sharing some intimate behind-the-scenes photos from their honeymoon in Italy on Monday (June 29).

Related

In some of the Instagram photos, Lipa shows off her tan and assortment of bikinis, posing in front of gorgeous waterfronts, on a boat and lounging on a luxurious beach chair. She also shared pics she snapped of the Fantastic Beasts actor making a silly face in front of their luxurious accommodations — Hotel Il Pellicano in Tuscany — and flashing his wedding band while out to dinner. Plus, the hitmaker posted a few snaps of the food she’s been dining on while abroad, as well as a cheeky photo of herself soaking up a bubble bath.

“heaven on earth,” she captioned the carousel.

Lipa and Turner got married on May 31 with an intimate ceremony at London’s Old Marylebone Town Hall. A few weeks later, they held a bigger wedding bash in Sicily featuring a star-studded guest list that included Elton John, Katy Perry and Troye Sivan.

The pair’s romance dates back to early 2024, when they met during drinks before a mutual friend’s birthday celebration. “We sat next to each other and realized we were reading the same book, which is crazy,” Turner told The Sunday Times in October. “It’s called Trust [by Hernán Díaz], and I had just finished the first chapter, and I told her, and she looked at me and said, ‘I just finished the first chapter too.’ I said, ‘So we’re on the same page.'”

The actor and singer announced their engagement in 2025, about one month after they made their red carpet debut as a couple that May.

Lipa last dropped music in 2024, reaching No. 2 on the Billboard 200 with Radical Optimism. Last year, she wrapped her tour in support of the album, grossing $141.1 million, according to Billboard Boxscore .
